shortDescription: Manage application settings for a DOS profile

options.name: geolocations
options.description: Manages the geolocations countries whitelist, blacklist.

options.name: heavy_urls
options.description: Manages Heavy URL protection. Heavy URLs are a small number of site URLs that might consume considerable server resources per request.

options.name: mobile_detection
options.description: Configures detection of mobile applications built with the Anti-Bot Mobile SDK and defines how requests from these mobile application clients are handled.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: profile
options.description: Specifies the name of the profile to manage application settings in.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: rtbh_duration
options.description: Specifies the duration of the RTBH BGP route advertisement, in seconds. The acceptable range is between 0 and 4294967295 inclusive.

options.name: rtbh_enable
options.description: Specifies whether to enable Remote Triggered Black Hole C(RTBH) of attacking IPs by advertising BGP routes.

options.name: scrubbing_duration
options.description: Specifies the duration of the Traffic Scrubbing BGP route advertisement, in seconds. The acceptable range is between 0 and 4294967295 inclusive.

options.name: scrubbing_enable
options.description: Specifies whether to enable Traffic Scrubbing during attacks by advertising BGP routes.

options.name: single_page_application
options.description: When C(true), specifies the system supports a Single Page Applications.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(state) is C(present), ensures that the Application object exists. When C(state) is C(absent), ensures that the Application object is removed.

options.name: trigger_irule
options.description: When C(true), specifies the system activates an Application DoS iRule event.
